groups.sentence: Instructors integrate AI into their teaching and courses where appropriate.
Students are welcome and expected to use generative AI tools in this class.
Instructors permit and encourage students to use AI responsibly.
Generative AI use is neither encouraged nor prohibited on assignments in this course.
Students may use generative AI tools in this course and on assignments.
Students are encouraged to use generative AI tools to support their learning and work.
Students may use generative AI only if they follow stated conditions, such as attribution, disclosure, or instructor guidelines.
Students may use generative AI freely, with no restrictions and no need to cite or document it.
Students may use generative AI only in limited ways or specific circumstances set by the course.
Students may use AI tools but should do so with caution.
Everyone in the university community is encouraged to explore and experiment with AI responsibly.
Universities support, embrace, and value AI use and responsible experimentation.
AI is a helpful tool that can improve students' learning, work quality and efficiency.
The university promotes and encourages AI adoption and responsible use among its members.
Instructors help students engage with AI, consider its ethical implications, and explore what they can create.
